plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026), §3.2; roadmap §30
deployment: none: a package released as git tags; services and apps pin a tag
features: redact (openvibe-sdk/redact): the shared secret scrubber for memory, the same shapes and corpus as OpenVibe.Node's internal/memory/redact.go (redact, onlySecret)
core client: retries, timeouts, problem+json errors, trace propagation
auth: service and app tokens, PKCE, offline verification, the Network signing keys (createNetworkKeys), revocation cutoffs
registry discovery and contracts version checks
events: publish, pull and checkpoints by opaque cursor only, app events, webhook verification (v2), outbox and inbox
realtime SSE (resumes from the opaque cursor, dedupes by event_id)
media files and objects v2
community, bot, search, bench, vision, chat, ai, jobs, tools, projects, modules, identity, openre, geo, vip, quest, play and download clients
bot (openvibe-sdk/bot): OpenVibe.Bot robots, operators, devices, streaming, commands and audit, the public kits and profiles, and pairing
per-actor limiter for services (openvibe-sdk/limits)
no-looks (openvibe-sdk/no-looks): public AI text never describes a person, one filter and corpus for every service
the OpenVibe Frame for any app
mock platform for tests (openvibe-sdk/testing)
createTestDb: one migrated test database per process, loaded from a PGlite snapshot keyed by the migrations (OV_TEST_SNAPSHOT=0 turns it off)
ESM entries, TypeScript types and a browser bundle

db (ADR-035): the async PostgreSQL data layer (node-postgres through PgBouncer; PGlite in tests) with safe sql fragments, retrying transactions and savepoints, versioned expand/migrate/contract migrations
valkey, cache, queue, pubsub and a shared limits store on Valkey 9, each with an in-process twin for tests
commerce (openvibe-sdk/commerce): the shared Billing client for Tips and VIP, with intentKey and receipt
events: the PostgreSQL outbox (lease-claimed, several relays per table) and inbox (handler in its transaction)

usage: createUsageReporter (openvibe-sdk/usage), the shared platform.usage-sample@1 reporter — validated readings queued idempotency-keyed in an outbox and relayed to Billing with retry, never dropped, refused readings kept

the HTTP telemetry kit (openvibe-sdk/service): the platform.telemetry-sample@1 middleware aggregated per route|method|status_class per flush, with active-requests, p95 and event-loop-lag gauges, lifted from Network's server/telemetry.js and server/observability.js
the telemetry sink (openvibe-sdk/telemetry): telemetrySchema() DDL, createPgTelemetrySink() and pruneTelemetry(), a per-service PostgreSQL table every service stores platform.telemetry-sample@1 into

account-data (openvibe-sdk/account-data, ADR-033): telemetry_samples covered once by the SDK (exported as telemetry.json, anonymized on deletion), and uncovered() listing every table with a person column that no table map, task-keyed list or reasoned exemption covers
resources (openvibe-sdk/resources): the ADR-048 resource index fan-out and the idempotent control client

placement v1 (openvibe-sdk/placement): place() with the person's rules and ownership, the quality bar, cost per success, learn/successOf, escalate and the one-line reason; plan() takes the optional success map and never defaults to user-owned
